project.name: namaa-tts-control-board
project.description: Local control board for Arabic TTS and zero-shot voice cloning. Branch `voicetut` registers one model: VoiceTut (Egyptian, OmniVoice/Qwen3-0.6B). Four more adapters (SILMA, NAMAA x2, Masri Higgs) exist but are unregistered.

environment.pythonVersionNote: Exactly 3.11 — silma-tts pins numpy<=1.26.4, which has no wheels for 3.12/3.13. The venv is provisioned with `uv venv --python 3.11`.
environment.webPort: dev.sh: first free from 43117 (SAWTAK_WEB_PORT); desktop app: OS-assigned
